name: Mura
source:
A tale set in a fictional island village. 
"Ai" partakes in the local custom of becoming a woman. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166828.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一座虚构岛屿上的村庄。
“Ai”参加了当地象征成为女人的习俗仪式。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166828.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
